rollups.text: Writing and editing tools used, considered, or recommended to the user: Grammarly was recommended by Amy on February 5, 2024; the user planned to try Grammarly Premium’s free trial on March 3, 2024, and later planned to continue using Grammarly (T16, T18, T72, T76). The user used Hemingway Editor and planned to keep using it by April 10, 2024 (T46, T72, T76). The user used Jasper AI on April 3, 2024, and later used its tone-calibration suggestions in August (T90, T246, T248). The user integrated ProWritingAid desktop into their process by May 21, 2024, but had earlier deferred investing in it before a screenplay deadline; on October 5, 2024, the user asked about using it to reduce adverbs (T44, T76, T220, T334). The user tracked writing with Google Docs and Scrivener, and used Scrivener project targets by August 15, 2024 (T22, T54, T72, T126, T282). The user created a Notion database for character backstories and plot points on August 1, 2024 (T272).

Writing collaborators, reviewers, and writing-community contacts: the user met Michael at the Montserrat Writers’ Festival on January 15, 2024, and they exchanged script-editing tips weekly; Joseph began peer-review sessions with the user on February 20, 2024, and the user shared edited scenes with him (T6, T12, T62). Amy recommended Grammarly Premium on February 5, 2024, suggested a peer review over Zoom in April, and co-hosted a workshop with the user on June 15, 2024 (T16, T70, T238). Carla shared an editing checklist on April 7, 2024, reviewed screenplay work, and was the user’s webinar co-host (T78, T84, T228, T286). The user met Megan on March 28, 2024, declined a collaboration request on April 9, and later worked with Megan on drafts beginning August 5, 2024 (T74, T110, T112). The user met 12 writing contacts at the East Janethaven Writers’ Meetup on April 8, 2024, and 30 writers and editors at the Montserrat Literary Festival on May 18, 2024 (T150, T216).

Screenplay and manuscript development timeline: the user completed a 12-scene screenplay outline on February 25, 2024, and set a goal to complete a 5,000-word screenplay draft by April 15 (T60, T20). The user reported completing a first draft on April 1, raising confidence from 4/10 to 7/10; this conflicts with later statements that they had never completed a screenplay first draft, so the discrepancy remains unresolved (T82; conflicting later record: T68). In April the user planned revisions focused on dialogue clarity, passive voice, character development, and plot structure, and on April 10 reported 10,000 total words and a target of 15,000 words (T84, T160, T168). On June 1 the user reported reaching 20,000 words, 33% above the initial 15,000-word target, and had incorporated three beta-reader-suggested subplots (T208, T212). The user aimed to complete a final draft by October 1, 2024, at 1,800 words per week, and later reported finishing a 35,000-word manuscript by that date—40% longer than the initial word-count goal (T242, T244, T302, T304). The user’s October 1 completion report does not specify whether this was the same screenplay or manuscript referred to in all earlier records.

The user’s writing-schedule and output targets changed over time. On March 3, 2024, the user struggled with a 1,200-word weekly target, later adjusted it to 1,350 words, and scheduled two-hour sessions at 7 PM on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays (T22, T24, T64). By April 9, the user had increased weekly output to 1,500 words and was unsure whether that pace was sustainable (T126). Starting May 18, the user added Saturday sessions at 10 AM to accommodate editing workload (T188). By August 15, the user reported averaging 1,700 words per day and tracking daily counts in Scrivener; separately, the user’s stated final-draft goal was 1,800 words per week (T282, T242, T244). These are different reported targets and time periods, not necessarily directly comparable measures.

Reported writing milestones: the user reached 10,000 total words by April 10, 2024; 20,000 total words by June 1, 2024; and surpassed 30,000 words on August 14, 2024. The user celebrated the 10,000-word milestone with dinner at The Coral Reef Restaurant and the 30,000-word milestone with dinner at The Blue Lagoon Café (T156, T158, T208, T284).

Reported writing and editing metric changes: the user said peer-review sessions with Joseph had improved drafts by 15% by March 3, 2024 (T12). After applying Carla’s checklist, the user reported an 18% reduction in passive voice on April 7, then reported passive voice decreasing from 18% to 10% between April 10 and May 31 (T78, T186). The user reported a 20% reduction in filler words during a 15-day clarity challenge from May 10 to May 25 (T218). The user reported improving a Flesch-Kincaid score from 65 to 72 by April 10, then from 72 on June 1 to 78 on August 10 (T162, T266). The user reported a 25% improvement in dialogue clarity by April 10 and a 10% improvement in grammar accuracy after integrating ProWritingAid by June 1 (T70, T220).

Peer feedback and revision timeline: the user began peer-review sessions with Joseph on February 20, 2024, and reported 15% draft improvement by March 3 (T12). Carla shared an editing checklist on April 7; the user applied it and reported reducing passive voice by 18%, then chose to revise independently using the checklist (T78, T80). By May 30, the user had received five detailed beta-reader critiques through Joseph’s network; on June 1 the user decided to group the critiques, prioritize recurring major issues—especially tone inconsistencies—preserve their creative vision, make tentative changes, and ask Carla for her opinion (T178, T180). By June 1 the user asked how to manage feedback from seven beta readers (T222). On August 7 the user received peer feedback and cut 1,200 words; on August 15 the user planned to compare draft versions and assess clarity and flow before deciding whether to restore material (T250, T252, T254).

The user’s confidence and writing anxiety changed over time. On April 1, 2024, completing a first draft reportedly raised confidence from 4/10 to 7/10 (T82). On May 25, beta feedback was associated with writing anxiety peaking at 7/10, which the user managed with Headspace (T184). On June 1, the user rated writing motivation 8/10, saying Amy’s invitation had renewed it (T214). On August 15, the user rated anxiety about deadlines and commitments at 5/10 and said daily walks helped; the user also said positive feedback from the June 15 workshop had brought a confidence boost to 9/10 (T274, T280, T240). On October 5, 2024, the user reported confidence at an all-time high of 10/10 after completing a final draft (T300).

The user and Amy co-hosted a writing workshop at East Janethaven Library on June 15, 2024, with 25 participants and a satisfaction rating of 4.8/5 (T238). The user later said the positive feedback had raised confidence to 9/10 (T240). Separately, the user and Carla planned a joint editing webinar initially scheduled for September 10, then rescheduled to September 17, 2024; the user sought at least 50 Montserrat Writers’ Guild attendees and favored a Q&A with Carla and exclusive editing content (T228, T230, T232, T286). A later account says the webinar was hosted September 10 with 52 writers and a 4.9/5 rating, conflicting with the reported September 17 rescheduling; the event date is unresolved (T292, T296).

The user planned a joint book launch with Amy at the East Janethaven Cultural Center for November 15, 2024; on October 5 the user said it had moved to November 22 and expressed concern about adjusting the writing schedule. The user said they felt excited about the launch (T298, T338). The latest stated date is November 22, 2024; completion of the event is not recorded.

After completing a 35,000-word final manuscript draft by October 1, 2024, the user scheduled literary-agent query submissions to begin October 10, targeting five agents and preferring to submit in batches of five (T302, T304, T320). The user had not confirmed that submissions were sent; a staggered weekly schedule through November 7 was assistant-proposed only (T305, T321). On October 5 the user said query submissions caused anxiety and recalled previously managing mild anxiety rated 4/10 with breathing exercises (T330).

The user attended or planned writing-related events: met Michael at the Montserrat Writers’ Festival on January 15, 2024 (T6); joined the East Janethaven Writers’ Meetup on April 8 and made 12 contacts (T150); attended the Montserrat Literary Festival on May 18 and met 30 writers and editors (T216); co-hosted a workshop with Amy at East Janethaven Library on June 15 with 25 participants (T238); registered for the Montserrat Writers’ Guild’s Advanced Tone Calibration workshop scheduled for August 20 (T268); planned to speak at the Montserrat Literary Festival on September 22 (T274); and was invited to moderate an AI editing panel at that festival on October 20 (T332). A September 10 webinar attendance report conflicts with the earlier rescheduling to September 17 (T286, T292).
